title: Add a visual supplier purchase exposure field designer
description: A purchasing user chooses finite fields and current filters on the existing supplier purchase exposure page, previews the authorized current page and exports selected-column CSV. Keep static view. Development only. Reuse ERP-031 SupplierPurchaseExposure.ForQueryAsync, its supplier/currency/date/link-status filters and bounded page; recheck the current user's purchase-order menu for every request, fail closed on missing permission and invalid filters, and use existing HTTP operation audit. Keep linked settlement evidence separate from ambiguous/unavailable references, preserve null unknown amounts and original currencies, and state this is not accounts payable or payment authority. No arbitrary SQL, migration, production SQL, real database execution, writes, secrets/.env change or deployment. Verify focused tests and safe Release build/test; no real-browser acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Existing page offers catalog-driven field chooser and sends only allowlisted fields and bounded current filters to ERP-148 preview.
Designer renders selected order, linked/ambiguous/unavailable and unknown receipt/settlement values with loading, empty, permission and network states.
Selected-column current-page CSV preserves unknowns and escapes formula-leading text; Node tests cover chooser, paging, rendering, CSV and failures; document workflow.
